facts.claim: Hymnary.org lists 'Be Thou my vision, O Lord of my heart' with versifier Eleanor Henrietta Hull and translator Mary E. Byrne (1905), sung to the tune SLANE.

Hymnary.org's worship notes say the source is an Irish poem attributed to the monk Dallan Forgaill, translated into English by Mary Elizabeth Byrne in the early 20th century and versified by Eleanor Hull in 1912; one hymnal instance gives the source as 'Irish, c. 8th century'.
Hymnary.org says SLANE is an old Irish folk tune, arranged by David Evans and set to 'Be Thou My Vision' in the Church Hymnary (1927).
Hymnary.org lists 'Amazing grace! (how sweet the sound)' by John Newton (1779), sung to the tune NEW BRITAIN.
Hymnary.org says Newton published the hymn in 1779 in the Olney Hymns, a collaboration with William Cowper, under the original title 'Faith's Review and Expectations'.
Hymnary.org describes NEW BRITAIN (also known as AMAZING GRACE) as an Appalachian folk tune that first appeared in Southern Harmony; the modern harmonisation is credited to Edwin Othello Excell.
Hymnary.org lists 'Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee' by Henry Van Dyke (1907), sung to the tune HYMN TO JOY.
facts.conflicts: Hymnary.org header dates the text 1907; its worship notes say 'around 1908'. Use 1907 (header) or 'early 1900s'.

facts.claim: Hymnary.org says HYMN TO JOY (ODE TO JOY) adapts the final movement of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony as a congregational melody, and that Van Dyke wrote his text to be sung to Beethoven's 'Hymn to Joy'.
Hymnary.org gives the tune's meter as 87.87.D.
'Perfect' is performed by Ed Sheeran and is taken from his third studio album, ÷.
'Perfect' by Ed Sheeran first entered the UK Official Singles Chart on 16/03/2017 (2017 release year), on the Asylum label.
'Perfect' entered the UK Official Singles Chart at Number 4 and climbed to Number 1, where it stayed for six weeks; it was Ed Sheeran's fourth UK Number 1 single.
The Official Charts Company notes versions of 'Perfect' released as a duet with Beyoncé and with Andrea Bocelli.
'At Last' is a song by Etta James, one of the songs that made her Chess Records' first major female star after she signed with Chess in 1960.
Etta James received four Grammy Awards, including a 2003 lifetime achievement award, and was inducted into the Grammy Hall of Fame (1999 and 2008) and the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame (1993).
Michael Giacchino won the Academy Award for Music (Original Score) for 'Up' at the 82nd Academy Awards, held Sunday 7 March 2010 and honouring movies released in 2009.
'Up' received 5 nominations and 2 wins at the 82nd Academy Awards: Music (Original Score) for Michael Giacchino and Animated Feature Film for Pete Docter.
'Amélie' (also known as 'Le Fabuleux Destin d'Amélie Poulain') is a 2001 film directed by Jean-Pierre Jeunet.
Ennio Morricone was an Italian composer, conductor and orchestrator.
'A Thousand Years' is performed by Christina Perri; it first entered the UK Official Singles Chart on 19/11/2011 on the Atlantic label (2011 release year).
'A Thousand Years' by Christina Perri peaked at Number 11 on the UK Official Singles Chart (peak week 28/09/2013).
'A Thousand Years' by Christina Perri peaked at Number 10 on the UK Official Singles Downloads Chart and at Number 13 on the UK Official Singles Sales Chart.
Adele's recording of 'Make You Feel My Love' first entered the UK Official Singles Chart on 25/10/2008 on the XL Recordings label (2008 release year).
Adele's 'Make You Feel My Love' peaked at Number 4 on the UK Official Singles Chart (peak week 09/10/2010) and reached Number 1 on the UK Official Independent Singles Chart.
The Library of Congress National Recording Registry lists 'At Last' (single) by Etta James with the year 1961, in the R&B category.
The Library of Congress FY2009 annual report states Etta James's 'At Last!' was named to the National Recording Registry in June 2009.
GRAMMY.com states Rascal Flatts' 'Bless The Broken Road' earned the group a GRAMMY nomination for 2005 for Best Country Performance By A Duo Or Group With Vocal.
Billboard reports Rascal Flatts' 'Bless the Broken Road' spent five weeks at No. 1 on Billboard's Hot Country Songs chart.
Russell Dickerson's official site lists 'Yours' among his No. 1 hits and describes it as 3X Platinum.
Billboard describes 'Yours' as Russell Dickerson's debut hit and reports it reached No. 1 on Billboard's Country Airplay chart (two weeks from January 2018).
Britannica describes Lohengrin as an opera by Richard Wagner, first performed on 28 August 1850 at Weimar, given by Franz Liszt.

Britannica describes The Four Seasons (Le quattro stagioni) as a group of four violin concerti by Antonio Vivaldi, written about 1720 and published in 1725 (Amsterdam) within Il cimento dell'armonia e dell'inventione; Spring is Concerto No. 1 in E major, in three movements (Allegro, Largo e pianissimo sempre, Allegro).
Britannica describes Clair de lune as the third movement of Suite bergamasque, a four-movement piano suite by Claude Debussy, begun in 1890 and revised and published in 1905.

IMSLP lists Franz Schubert's Ave Maria (alternative title Ellens Gesang III / Hymne an die Jungfrau), D.839, Op.52 No.6, for voice and piano, composed April 1825 and first published 1826; text is Adam Storck's German translation after Walter Scott's The Lady of the Lake (1810).
IMSLP lists Edward Elgar's Salut d'amour (Love's Greeting; Liebesgruss), Op.12, for violin and piano, composed 1888, first published 1889 (London: Schott), dedicated to Caroline Alice Elgar.

insider_details.detail: Amazing Grace is short in common meter and Hymnary.org notes most hymnals print four of Newton's stanzas plus a later anonymous fifth; for a ceremony, agree with the musician which verses to sing so the hymn fits the signing or a reflection moment.

Joyful, Joyful, We Adore Thee uses Beethoven's Ode to Joy melody, so it works for guests who don't know hymns: they will recognise the tune even if the words are new. Print the words in the order of service.

Be Thou My Vision is sung to an Irish folk tune (SLANE), which suits couples wanting an Irish or Celtic thread in a church ceremony, and is often played slowly; ask the musician to keep the tempo moving so it doesn't drag.

If a couple loves 'Perfect' but wants a gentler walk, the Official Charts Company lists duet versions with Beyoncé and with Andrea Bocelli, so check which recording the musicians or DJ will play before the day.
